title: Abutment of a first-quadrant spectral object
statement: Let C be abelian and Y an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object. Its standard E2 spectral sequence on nonnegative bidegrees abuts to n↦H^n_Y(bottom,top), with a finite decreasing image filtration in every total degree.

proof.text: Filter H^n(bottom,top) by the images of H^n(bottom,n+1-p). These images decrease in p. First-quadrant vanishing makes the p=0 step top and the p=n+1 step bottom.

The opcycle short exact sequence identifies successive image quotients with stabilized spectral-object page terms. The existing page comparison and first-quadrant vanishing identify these with the page at p+q+2. These data form E₂SpectralSequenceNatAbutment. Take its Nonempty witness. This is the existing sorry-free library proof.
